Name: Verify that the Discuss tab is selected and highlighted by default when the panel opens
Description: Checks that the Discuss tab's enclosing nav-link element carries the 'active' class immediately after the panel opens, without clicking any tab.

Name: Verify that a user can be blocked from a comment's three-dots menu with a reason
Description: Blocks the author of a specific comment via that comment's three-dots menu, providing a reason, and confirms the blocked-user indicator appears.

Name: Given there are discussion posts with reactions==Like by logged in user, when I try to update the reaction with other emojis such as 'Clap' by hovering over the Like button, then I should see the Like text changing to 'Clap' and You reacted section
Verify that a long post renders its full description without breaking the layout
Description: Posts a description far longer than a typical post and confirms the full text is present on the page afterwards.

Name: Verify that clicking 'Add files' triggers the native file chooser
Description: Confirms clicking the 'Add files' control fires a native file-chooser event.

Name: Given a post has a file attachment, when the user likes it, then the post should show 'You reacted'
Verify that an uploaded file's Download button downloads the file
Description: Posts a file attachment then clicks its Download button, confirming a real download is triggered with the original filename.

Name: Verify that a user can block another user without providing a reason and that the blocked user indicator appears in the Discuss tab
Verify that a user can successfully create a post with description only (no subject) in the My Posts tab

Name: Verify that the Edit popup opens pre-populated with the post's existing subject and description

Name: Verify that a user can successfully add a comment to a post in the My Posts tab
Verify that the share-post section (subject, description, and Post button) is visible on the Discuss tab

Name: Verify that uploading more than 5 documents shows a 'Maximum number of files Exceeded' error message in the My Posts tab
Verify that a block action persists after refreshing the page

Verify that choosing No on Unblock Discussion leaves the post blocked

Name: Verify that a user can be blocked from a comment's three-dots menu without a reason

Verify that the Discuss tab remains selected after refreshing the page
